text:
Maya D: quick recap from retro — we keep mis-attributing GPU-ms when the shared gateway batches multiple tenants. want a pragmatic pattern we can ship fast.

Ali K: concrete ask: product needs per-tenant cost in dashboards, but we can't emit per-token lineage. what's the middle ground?

Maya D: propose emitting a compact batch_summary from gateway with batch_id, node_id, region, total_gpu_ms, and a small map of tenant->token_count. bounded and cheap.

Samir P: +1 boundedness. ingest must dedupe by batch_id first-wins to avoid double-count on retries. add short TTL for dedupe keys.

Jen L: include model_pool and an exclusive flag so pinned pools don't get prorated. that'll avoid breaking tenant pin semantics.

Ali K: fallback rule: if tenant counts missing (old clients), attribute by recent request-count ratio on that node in a small window. logged and documented.

Maya D: operational plan: 1) land ingest dedupe & TTL this sprint, 2) schema + SDK helper next sprint, 3) audit/backfill pipeline in 2-3 sprints for full lineage when finance requests.

Samir P: question: late-arriving summaries — make ingest idempotent and use first-wins, then allow backfill to correct numbers for audits.

Jen L: I'll add dashboard query examples (group by tenant, region, prorated sum of gpu_ms).

obsv-bot: schema draft pushed to //git.redwood/infr/obs/batch-summary-proposal.md — review requested.

Maya D: action items: Maya write RFC follow-up, Jen PR schema + dashboard snippets, Samir land dedupe change, Ali ping Finance re: whether prorated GPU-ms is acceptable for billing. Thanks all :thumbsup:
